name: Signed Off, Moved On
overview: Maya Shaw, heiress of Isburg, sacrifices her sight to save Cody Reed and marries him-only to witness his affair with his secretary on the day she regains her vision. Heartbroken, she inherits her mentor's legacy and divorces Cody. But as she begins to thrive in the medical field with Wayne Cox by her side, Cody regrets everything and desperately tries to win her back.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
